review: 702.165c-1: the Brute Strength variant gave Assailant trample after the backup trigger was already on the stack, so 702.165d alone excluded it and 702.165c was never what flipped the outcome; rebuilt with Herald of Dromoka granting vigilance before the trigger goes on the stack, contrasted with Sigiled Sentinel printing vigilance below backup.

702.165d-1: target_removed (Shock kills the target, trigger fizzles) illustrated 608.2b, not 702.165d; variant dropped with Shock and B's Mountain, and the missing does_not_fire branch explained in forge_notes.

scenarios.title: Backup puts counters on the target and grants it the abilities printed below backup

setup.notes: Serpent-Blade Assailant is {2}{G} 2/1 with backup 1 and deathtouch printed below it. Grizzly Bears (2/2) has been under A's control since earlier turns.

decisions: A casts Serpent-Blade Assailant, tapping three Forests. It resolves and enters.
The backup trigger targets Grizzly Bears. Both players pass; it resolves.
The turn proceeds to the cleanup step.

variants.label: another_creature
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains deathtouch until end of turn; Serpent-Blade Assailant stays a 2/1 with deathtouch. At the cleanup step Grizzly Bears loses deathtouch and keeps its counter.

variants.label: itself
variants.delta: The backup trigger targets Serpent-Blade Assailant itself.
variants.expected: Serpent-Blade Assailant gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2). Nothing is granted since the target is not another creature; it keeps its own deathtouch. Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2 with no deathtouch.

scenarios.title: A copy of a backup creature keeps the printed ability order and its backup grants the abilities below it

setup.notes: Serpent-Blade Assailant and Grizzly Bears have been under A's control since earlier turns.

decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands. It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Serpent-Blade Assailant.
The backup trigger of the copy targets Grizzly Bears. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: copy_of_backup
variants.expected: Clone enters as a Serpent-Blade Assailant copy (2/1) and its backup trigger fires. Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains deathtouch until end of turn.

variants.label: copy_of_bears
variants.delta: A has Clone enter as a copy of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Clone enters as a 2/2 Grizzly Bears copy with no backup. No trigger fires and the original Grizzly Bears is a 2/2 with no counter and no deathtouch.

scenarios.title: Backup grants only abilities printed on the creature, not abilities it has gained

setup.notes: Serpent-Blade Assailant is a {2}{G} 2/1 Elf Warrior with backup 1 and deathtouch printed below it. Herald of Dromoka (2/2 Human Warrior, vigilance) gives other Warrior creatures A controls vigilance, so Assailant has vigilance it did not print from the moment it enters. Grizzly Bears (2/2 Bear, not a Warrior) and Herald have been under A's control since earlier turns.

decisions: A casts Serpent-Blade Assailant, tapping Forest, Forest and Plains. It resolves and enters.
The backup trigger targets Grizzly Bears and goes on the stack. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: gained_vigilance
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains deathtouch until end of turn. It does not gain vigilance, which Assailant has only from Herald of Dromoka. Serpent-Blade Assailant is a 2/1 with deathtouch and vigilance.

variants.label: printed_vigilance
variants.delta: A's hand holds Sigiled Sentinel ({2}{W} 2/2 Human Knight with backup 1 and vigilance printed below it) instead of Serpent-Blade Assailant, cast by tapping Forest, Forest and Plains.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains vigilance until end of turn, since vigilance is printed below backup on Sigiled Sentinel.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge grants a backup creature's printed abilities from the BackupAbility SVar, so a keyword from a static effect such as Herald of Dromoka's is not part of the grant.

scenarios.title: The granted abilities are fixed when the backup ability goes on the stack

setup.notes: Serpent-Blade Assailant is {2}{G} 2/1 with backup 1 and deathtouch printed below it. Grizzly Bears (2/2) has been under A's control since earlier turns. B holds Turn to Frog {1}{U} and has two Islands; B passes in the base case.

decisions: A casts Serpent-Blade Assailant, tapping three Forests. It resolves and enters.
The backup trigger targets Grizzly Bears and goes on the stack.
Both players pass until the stack is empty, unless the variant has B respond.

variants.label: no_response
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains deathtouch until end of turn.

variants.label: source_loses_abilities
variants.delta: In response to the backup trigger B casts Turn to Frog on Serpent-Blade Assailant, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Serpent-Blade Assailant becomes a 1/1 blue Frog with no abilities until end of turn. The backup trigger still resolves: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and gains deathtouch until end of turn, as the abilities were determined when the trigger went on the stack.

scenarios.forge_notes: 702.165d has no does_not_fire branch: it only says the granted set does not change, and an ability the source gains after the trigger is on the stack is unprinted, so 702.165c already excludes it.
